# ChoroplethJoin

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Join tabular data onto geographic boundaries (US states, world countries, Canadian provinces) to produce a colored FeatureCollection.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/choropleth-join",
  "type": "ChoroplethJoinOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/choropleth-join').par.data` (an input) and `op('/choropleth-join').out.features` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.data`, `out.features`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `data` | `DataField` | `[]` |
| `geography` | `StringLiteralField` | `"us-states"` |
| `boundaries` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
| `joinKey` | `StringLiteralField` | `""` |
| `geoKey` | `StringLiteralField` | `"auto"` |
| `customSQL` | `CodeField` | `""` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs
